race.comment: ANOTHER CASHIE (1) versatile gelding who makes plenty of appeal fourth up with J Mac aboard. Was a month between runs when he dropped in grade for a tough victory over 1200m at Doomben in C1 class. Will appreciate the fast tempo here and can drop on them late. YESSPECIALLY (11) lightly raced gelding with a bright future. Was an easing fav on resumption with a narrow third over 1200m at this track. Peaked on the run last start and shapes as the main danger with the similar set up. OLE STEELE (8) undefeated this prep and gets her chance here after leading throughout in a Cl1 at Scone over 900m. Sure to be thereabouts. PIETRO ROAD (7) holding his form and not to be overlooked.
